lines.t:
A state in which <c:ffff00>evading<c> is not possible.

If an <c:ffff00>action<c>, <c:ffff00>{{negative_status}}<c> or other {{effect}} makes
evasion impossible, even a <c:ffff00>legs {{part}}<c> capable of
evading can't give the evade <c:ffff00>{{response}}<c>; having the
legs {{part}} destroyed amounts to the same thing.

If an attack is <c:ffff00>taken<c> while <c:ffff00>unable to defend<c> and
unable to evade, it is always <c:ffff00>{{critical}}<c>.
